entities.name: Florian Mühlstein
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Florian Mühlstein is an Austrian professional ice hockey defenseman currently an unrestricted free agent. He most recently played for EC VSV of the Austrian Hockey League (EBEL). He has previously played in the EBEL for EC KAC and EC Red Bull Salzburg.
